About.body: SPLITZ is an evolving platform concept for fitness coaches and their clients. The goal is to bring program delivery, tracking, and management into a focused experience. This version is a UI prototype under development.

strength.overview: An introductory strength concept built around consistency, movement confidence, and a manageable weekly routine.
strength.audience: People starting structured strength training who want a clear, beginner-friendly weekly schedule.
strength.equipment: Basic gym equipment, or suitable alternatives where available.

upper.overview: An intermediate sample split that alternates upper and lower body sessions across the week.
upper.audience: Trainees familiar with the basics who prefer dedicated upper and lower body training days.
upper.equipment: General gym equipment, including resistance options.

home.overview: A simple fitness concept designed for home training with flexible equipment needs.
home.audience: Beginners who want an accessible routine they can follow in a small space.
home.equipment: Exercise mat and optional bands or dumbbells; equipment depends on the eventual workouts.

ppl.overview: An intermediate five-day concept that organizes training into push, pull and leg-focused sessions.
ppl.audience: Trainees who can commit to more weekly sessions and are comfortable with gym basics.
ppl.equipment: Gym resistance equipment appropriate to the final program.

conditioning.overview: A general-fitness sample combining manageable full-body movement and conditioning work.
conditioning.audience: Beginners looking for a varied weekly routine focused on general fitness.
conditioning.equipment: Open space; some sessions may use simple gym or home equipment.

mobility.overview: A short movement-oriented concept with a focus on preparation, control, and comfortable range of motion.
mobility.audience: Trainees of different levels who want dedicated movement-practice sessions.
mobility.equipment: Mat and a clear floor space; optional simple accessories.

AboutCoachPage.heroBody: Good training should be understandable and sustainable. SPLITZ helps coaches deliver structured programs and gives clients a clear path through each session.

AboutCoachPage.storyLead: It is not simply about doing more. Every session should have a purpose, with instructions that clients can revisit whenever they need them.
AboutCoachPage.storyBody: This is a starting template for a coach biography, training philosophy, and specialties. When SPLITZ is customized for a real coach, these sections should use verified information — not invented credentials or achievements.
AboutCoachPage.approachIntro: These are product design principles, not guaranteed physical outcomes or claims about a particular coach.

AboutCoachPage.stepTwoBody: Keep the experience focused, resume sessions, and record completed workouts.
AboutCoachPage.stepThreeBody: Present exercise guidance and training objectives without unnecessary distractions.

accessRequest.question: How will I join a program?
accessRequest.answer: For now, you can browse fictional sample programs and read their details. In a future release, you will create an account, request access to a program, and wait for the coach to approve or reject the request.

payment.question: Can I pay online right now?
payment.answer: No. This preview does not collect payments. Payment integration is planned for a later stage, and requesting access will not be treated as proof of purchase.

approval.question: When will full workouts become available?
approval.answer: Once account and approval features are implemented, protected workout content will be available only to members with access granted by the coach. This is not active in the current demo.

beginner.question: Are there beginner-friendly programs?
beginner.answer: The demo catalog includes programs labeled for different difficulty levels, including beginners. Check the goal and level on each program page; these are fictional sample details for now.

choosing.question: How do I choose the right program?
choosing.answer: Compare goals, experience levels, and weekly training frequency using catalog filters. If you have an injury or a health concern, consult a qualified professional before starting a program.

equipment.question: Do all programs require gym equipment?
equipment.answer: Not necessarily. The platform is designed to support different goals and equipment requirements, including home workouts. Final requirements will be listed on each program detail page when real content is added.

dashboard.question: What will the member dashboard include?
dashboard.answer: The planned dashboard will show your unlocked programs, training weeks and days, exercises, and recorded progress. The working dashboard is not part of this preview yet.

videos.question: Will exercises include demonstration videos?
videos.answer: The platform will support demonstration videos from approved, properly licensed sources or coach-provided content. Availability for each exercise will depend on the content the coach adds.

progress.question: Will my progress be saved between sessions?
progress.answer: After accounts and the database are integrated, completed workouts and progress will be stored for each member. Persistent progress tracking is not active in the current demo.
